conf.description: MOVEit Transfer audit, syslog-kv: hand-built Key:Value body parse (colon-split loop, not the kvp parser's unverified defaults) into ECS + moveit.transfer.*, per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: moveit-mft / audit / syslog-kv: Progress MOVEit Transfer's SysLog audit feed - a free-text summary line followed by newline-separated 'Key: Value' pairs mirroring the 'log' table columns. No Elastic integration or Cribl pack exists (confirmed absent per the map), so this hand-built pipeline splits the summary line from the KV block, parses each 'Key: Value' line with a colon-split loop (avoids relying on unverified kvp-parser delimiter defaults for values containing spaces), runs the Action-code lookup for event.category (file_*/sec_signon(off)/user_*|perm_*), derives event.outcome from Error while retaining the numeric code, converts Duration to nanoseconds, gates TargetName on the Action family per the map's warning, and caps/truncates Cert, FolderPath and Parm1-4 per recommendations.direct.cribl. Needs a review cadence tied to MOVEit upgrades adding new action codes.

functions.description: record parsing scope and the design decisions this pipeline makes
split the free-text summary line from the newline-separated Key: Value block, per recommendations.direct.cribl

conf.code: var lines=(__e['_kvblock']||'').split('\n'); for (var i=0;i<lines.length;i++){ var line=lines[i]; if(!line) continue; var idx=line.indexOf(':'); if(idx<0) continue; var k=line.substring(0,idx).trim(); var v=line.substring(idx+1).trim(); if(k){ __e[k]=v; } }

functions.description: deterministically split each 'Key: Value' line on its first colon (values may contain spaces/colons themselves, e.g. timestamps and file paths) into top-level fields named after the log table columns

batch-rename the status:mapped/unmapped-with-custom-target fields that need no computation; host->host.name assumes Cribl's syslog source populates the envelope hostname as 'host' (unverified against a live MOVEit feed, documented in README)

String(__e['Parm3']).substring(0,4096) : undefined, parm4: __e['Parm4'] ? String(__e['Parm4']).substring(0,4096) : undefined }
